svg.aria-label: Stack as a Renaissance night landscape: a castle on a hill with its town running down to the river, a moonlit lake, forests, fields and roads; curved shooting stars carry each technology down to its settlement — DATA: SQL, PostgreSQL, Apache Iceberg, MinIO; NOSQL: MongoDB, Cassandra; STREAMING: Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, Spark Streaming, Apache Flink; ML & AI: PyTorch, scikit-learn, MLflow, GANs, LLMs; OPS: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Airflow, Prometheus, Grafana; BACKEND: Python, Flask, WebSockets; FRONTEND: HTML, CSS; TOOLS: Git, Linux, Jupyter, Google Colab.
